subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I fell / asleep while / I read / the book.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: I read

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, indicating that the action of falling asleep and reading the book happened in the past.
 
• The verb "**fell**" is in the past tense and correctly describes the action of falling asleep.
 
• The word "**asleep**" is an adverb describing how the action of falling asleep occurred.
 
• The segment "**I read**" contains a grammatical error because the verb "**read**" is in the present tense, which does not match the past tense of the rest of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence**: *I fell asleep while I was reading the book. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**the book**", is a noun phrase that correctly identifies the object being read.
 
• "**asleep while**", is a prepositional phrase that correctly describes the circumstance in which the action of falling asleep occurred.
 
• "**I fell**", is a verb phrase that correctly describes the action of falling asleep.
